scenes.text: Your kid didn't choose to watch 2 hours. Autoplay chose for them.

scenes.title: Turn off autoplay.
scenes.body: In every video app your kid uses — **usually under Settings → Playback.**

scenes.title: Limit video apps, not the device.
scenes.body: A daily cap **just for video apps** — homework apps stay open.

scenes.title: End on a clear signal.
scenes.body: **"Two episodes, then the tablet goes on the shelf"** beats "a little longer."
